title: Rename a network interface
summary: Assign a custom, meaningful name to a network interface for easier identification.

steps.explain: Use `sudo ip link set` with the `alias` option to give the interface a new name.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The current name of the network interface.

placeholders.name: NEW_NAME
placeholders.description: The new name you want to assign to the interface.

alternatives.explain: Use the short form `sudo ip l s` with `al` for alias.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The current name of the network interface.

placeholders.name: NEW_NAME
placeholders.description: The new name you want to assign to the interface.

rollback.explain: To remove the alias, set the alias to an empty string.

warnings: Renaming an interface might break scripts or configurations that rely on the original name.
